description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.4.3
- Faster text recognition, smoother text highlighting, and optional GPU acceleration. / 文字识别更快，文字高亮更流畅，并支持可选 GPU 加速。
- Share screenshots with AirDrop on macOS and choose a menu bar icon that follows system colors. / macOS 支持通过隔空投送分享截图，菜单栏图标可跟随系统颜色。
- Crop images more precisely with boundary guides; the macOS editing toolbar stays above the preview. / 裁剪新增边界辅助线，修复 macOS 编辑工具栏被预览遮挡的问题。
- History remembers your preferred page size and keeps selection controls visible while scrolling. / 历史记录记住每页数量，滚动时仍可使用选择操作栏。
- More reliable capture on HDR displays and a more stable recording toolbar. / 改善 HDR 显示器截图兼容性，提升录屏工具栏稳定性。
- Portable builds leave system integrations disabled by default. / 便携版默认关闭系统集成。
Download guide / 下载指南
Snow Shot includes all features. Mini is smaller, with capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR. / 完整版提供全部功能；Mini 体积更小，保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏及手动 OCR。

Online builds download OCR when needed; offline builds include its runtime and default model. Portable builds run after extraction. Other files (-update.zip, .json, .sha256, -homebrew.tar.gz) are for updates, verification, or package managers. / 在线版按需下载 OCR，离线版内含 OCR 组件和默认模型，便携版解压即用；其他文件用于更新、校验或包管理器。
Quick macOS install / macOS 快速安装
Run in Terminal without sudo; add --edition mini to install Mini. / 复制到终端运行，无需添加 sudo；末尾添加 --edition mini 可安装 Mini。
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.4.3_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
The installer verifies and locally signs the app. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility when prompted. For Gitee downloads, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com above. / 安装器会校验并本机签名，请按提示授予屏幕录制及辅助功能权限；使用 Gitee 下载时，将上方链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。
